DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自宅の防犯についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about security at your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 玄関が夜に暗くなるので、照明の置き方について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜の玄関照明について防犯相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Our entrance becomes dark at night, so I would like advice on where to place lighting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for security advice about lighting the entrance at night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 玄関の様子が分かる写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a photograph showing the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。門から玄関まで、植木で少し隠れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 植木で隠れた門から玄関を写真で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is a photo. Plants partly obscure the area from the gate to the front door.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the photograph to explain the plants obscuring the route from gate to front door. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人の出入りが見えにくいですね。照明や植木の手入れを含めて考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is hard to see people coming and going. You could consider lighting and tending the plants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人が来ると点く照明を考えています。隣の家の窓に光が向かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人感照明の希望と隣家への光を避けたい条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am considering a light that comes on when someone approaches. I want to avoid directing light toward my neighbor's windows.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the motion-sensor light you want and the condition of not shining into your neighbor's windows. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 向きは取付け業者にも相談してください。門と通路のどこを照らすか整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss the angle with the installer too. Let us identify which parts of the gate and path to illuminate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の足元を照らしたいです。防犯カメラも一緒に相談した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元照明を希望しカメラ相談を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to light the ground along the path. Should I ask about a security camera at the same time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request lighting at foot level and ask about consulting on a camera. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 設置目的と撮影範囲を決めて、担当者に相談できます。防犯の資料もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Decide the purpose and recording area, then consult the staff in charge. We also have security information materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 資料をもらいます。写真に照らしたい範囲を書いて、業者へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料と照射範囲入り写真で業者へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the materials. I will mark the area I want lit on the photo and consult an installer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult the installer with the materials and a photo marked with the lighting area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お役に立てれば幸いです。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope this helps. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ会社の別の部署へ送ります。それぞれ別の封筒のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ会社宛て二通を別封筒で送ると指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They are for different departments of the same company. Please send each in its own envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify that two letters to one company should remain in separate envelopes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらも同じ住所ですが、部署名が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both have the same address but different department names, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは経理部、もう一つは人事部です。封筒の重さも違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二部署の名称と重さの違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is for Accounting and the other for Human Resources. The envelopes weigh different amounts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two department names and different weights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一通ずつ量ります。こちらは軽く、もう一通は規格を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will weigh each separately. This one is light; the other needs its size category checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 厚い方には冊子が入っています。中身を出さずに厚さを測れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冊子入り封筒を開けずに厚さ測定できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The thicker one contains a booklet. Can you measure its thickness without taking the contents out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the booklet envelope's thickness can be measured without opening it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 封筒のまま測れます。こちらの料金になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can measure it in the envelope. This will be the postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料金が別々だと分かりました。二通の合計を払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別料金を理解して合計の支払いを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the postage is different for each. I will pay the total for both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the separate postage and offer to pay the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりの前に、両方に差出人が書かれているかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before handing them over, please check that the sender is written on both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 両方とも裏に書きました。部署名を変えずに、この二通を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人を確認し部署名を保って二通を差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote it on the back of both. I will send these two without changing the department names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the sender and hand over both letters with department names unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かに二通お預かりしました。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received two letters. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座情報で分からないところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything unclear in the account details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先に名義を伝えます。このカナの小さい「ャ」は、そのまま書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先へ伝える名義の小さいカナを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to give my employer the account holder name. Should I copy this small kana “ャ” as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the small kana in the account name to give your employer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 当行に登録されている表記はこちらです。入力先によって、小さい文字の扱いが違う場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the spelling registered with our bank. Different input systems may handle small characters differently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録の表記をまず写します。最後の「ー」も省かない方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録表記を書き写し長音の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will copy the registered spelling first. Should I also avoid omitting the final “ー”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Copy the registered spelling and ask how to handle the long-vowel mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この口座の名義には長音が入っています。登録どおりにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This account name includes a long-vowel mark. Give it exactly as registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写しました。名前の間の空白も、この通りに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長音と空白を含めて写したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have copied it. I will also report the spaces between the names exactly like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have copied the long-vowel mark and spaces too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。勤務先の入力画面で使えない文字があれば、担当の方からご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If your employer's input screen cannot accept a character, ask their staff to contact us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀行側で、今すぐ大きい文字の名義に変える必要はないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入力先の都合だけで名義変更が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I do not need to have the bank change the name to large kana immediately, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether an account-name change is needed just because of the receiving system. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今すぐ名義を変えず、入力先の仕様を先にお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not change the account name immediately. First check the receiving system's specifications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この登録表記を勤務先へ渡します。入力できない場合だけ、担当から問い合わせてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録表記を渡し入力困難時の問合せを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give my employer this registered spelling. Only if they cannot enter it will I ask their staff to inquire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to provide the registered spelling and have staff inquire if input is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 惣菜の予約のお客様ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an order for prepared food, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方五時の予約ですが、六時に受け取りたいです。時間を変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取予約を五時から六時へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My pickup reservation is for 5 p.m., but I would like to collect it at 6. Can I change the time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request changing the pickup from five to six. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約のお名前と、商品の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the reservation name and what you ordered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山田です。小さい弁当を四つ予約しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名と小さい弁当四つを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yamada. I ordered four small bento boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and four small bento boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約を確認できました。六時まで保管できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I found your reservation. We can keep it until six.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。追加で一つ欲しいのですが、同じ弁当はまだ頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ弁当一つの追加を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I would like one more. Can I still order another of the same bento?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to add one identical bento. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じものは四つまでです。店頭の別のお弁当なら追加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide only four of that kind. You can add a different bento from the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約の四つはそのままにします。追加の分は、受け取りのときに売場で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約数を維持し別商品は当日選ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the four reserved ones as they are. I will choose the extra from the sales area when I collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep the reserved quantity and decide to choose a different item on pickup day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約分の支払いも、受け取りのときで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. You may also pay for the reserved items when collecting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六時に来て、予約の四つを受け取ります。そのあと、別の弁当を一つ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六時の予約受取と追加購入の順を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will come at six and collect the four reserved bentos. Then I will choose one different bento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the order of collecting the reservation at six and making the extra purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will be waiting. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生会にご参加ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you joining the outdoor sketching event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。画板は持っていますが、絵の具を置く小さい机を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写生用の小机を借りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have a drawing board, but could I borrow a small table to put my paints on?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow a small table for sketching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折り畳み机があります。置く場所はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have folding tables. Have you decided where to put one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の近くの木陰を考えています。通路から離れて置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池の近くの通路外に置く計画を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am thinking of the shade near the pond. I will place it away from the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to place it near the pond, off the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付から運ぶ必要があります。一人で持てる重さか、試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to carry it from reception. Please try whether it is light enough to carry alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持てます。脚を開いたときの固定の仕方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち運べると答え脚の固定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can carry it. Please show me how to lock the legs when opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can carry it and ask how to lock the legs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この金具を、左右とも止まる位置まで動かします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Move these metal fittings on both sides until they stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 固定できました。返すときは脚を畳んで、ここへ持ってくればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 固定を終え畳んだ机の返却先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are locked. When returning it, should I fold the legs and bring it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After locking the legs, confirm where to return the folded table. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。絵の具が付いた所は拭いてからお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Wipe off any paint before returning it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 布を持っています。終わったら机を拭いて畳み、受付へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 布で拭いて畳み受付へ返すと約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a cloth. When finished, I will wipe the table, fold it, and return it to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to wipe with a cloth, fold, and return the table to reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、写生をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの券についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the ticket you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この回数券が一枚残っています。今日は途中の駅まで行くのですが、使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残りの回数券で途中駅へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one ticket left from this multi-ride ticket set. I am going only to an intermediate station today. Can I use it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the remaining multi-ride ticket can be used to an intermediate station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券面の区間内の駅でしょうか。行き先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the station within the section printed on the ticket? Please tell me your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 終点の二つ手前の駅です。この区間の中に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 区間内の終点二つ手前と行き先を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is two stations before the terminus. It is within this section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the destination is within the section, two stops before the terminus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この券では、その駅で降りられます。ただし、差額の返金はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can get off there with this ticket. However, the fare difference is not refunded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返金は要りません。降りるとき、この券は回収されるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返金不要と答え降車時の券回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not need a refund. This ticket will be collected when I get off, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say no refund is needed and confirm collection of the ticket on exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その一枚の利用が終わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. That one ticket's use will be finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。日付は来週までですが、今日も使えると確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券の有効期間と今日の利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The date is valid through next week, but could you confirm it can be used today too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the ticket's validity period and today's use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券面の有効期間内です。今日のご利用に問題ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today is within the validity period printed on the ticket. There is no problem using it today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は残りの一枚で途中の駅へ行きます。降りたあと、この券は残らないと覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残り一枚で途中駅へ行き利用終了を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the remaining ticket to that intermediate station today. I will remember that I will not have this ticket after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the last ticket to an intermediate station and acknowledge that its use ends there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災訓練のお手伝いについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about helping with the disaster-preparedness drill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベトナム語で受付の案内を手伝いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベトナム語で防災訓練受付を手伝うと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to help explain reception procedures in Vietnamese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer to help with drill reception in Vietnamese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 話せる言語と、参加できる時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the languages you speak and when you can participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語と日本語です。朝九時から十一時まで参加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用言語と参加可能時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese and Japanese. I am available from nine to eleven in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the languages and available hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 避難誘導の判断は職員が行います。受付で名簿や会場案内を説明する役割を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will make evacuation-guidance decisions. We are considering a role explaining the register and venue directions at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その役割なら手伝いたいです。案内に使う言葉を先に見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職員の判断と分けた受付役を選び説明文を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to help in that role. Could you show me the wording used for the explanations beforehand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the reception role separate from staff decision-making and ask for the explanation text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明文をお渡しできます。意味が取りにくい部分を担当と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can give you the text. Discuss any unclear meaning with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読みました。「集合場所」と「受付場所」は違うので、訳し分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合場所と受付場所の訳し分けを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have read it. “Assembly point” and “reception location” are different, so I want to translate them distinctly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss distinguishing the assembly point and reception location in translation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会場図もあります。二つの場所を担当と照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have a venue map too. Let us check the two locations with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図に印を付けました。担当と訳を合わせてから、当日の受付に参加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図と訳を担当と合わせて参加すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I marked the map. I will coordinate the translations with the person in charge before helping at reception on the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will align the map and translations with staff before participating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: よろしくお願いいたします。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to working with you. Thank you for helping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か必要な物がありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予定より早く生理が来てしまいました。ナプキンを持っていないのですが、一つ分けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定より早い月経で持参なしと伝え予備ナプキンを一つ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My period started earlier than expected. I did not bring any sanitary pads. Could you spare one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your unexpectedly early period and lack of supplies, and ask for one spare pad. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病棟に予備があります。普通の長さと、長い物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have spares on the ward. There are regular-length and long ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今夜も使うので、長い物をお願いします。自分で交換できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長い物を選び自分で交換可能と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will use it tonight too, so please give me a long one. I can change it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a long one and say you can change it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの未開封の物をどうぞ。明日の分は売店でも買えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is an unopened one. You can also buy tomorrow's supplies at the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受け取りました。売店が開くのは朝何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封用品を受け取り翌日の売店開始時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have it. What time does the shop open in the morning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Receive the unopened item and ask the shop's opening time tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 朝八時です。病棟の外へ出る前に、こちらへ声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Eight in the morning. Please speak to us before leaving the ward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八時に買いに行く前に声をかけます。使った物を入れる箱は、トイレにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病棟退出前の声掛けを了承し使用済用品の処分箱を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell you before going to buy some at eight. Is there a disposal bin in the toilet for used pads?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to tell staff before leaving the ward and ask about the used-pad disposal bin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 便器の横のふた付きの箱へ、紙で包んで入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wrap them in paper and place them in the lidded bin beside the toilet bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙で包んで、その箱へ入れます。今はいただいた物を使い、明日売店で追加を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包んで指定箱へ処分し今夜使用と翌朝購入を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wrap them in paper and put them in that bin. I will use this one now and buy more at the shop tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wrap and dispose in the designated bin, use the pad tonight, and buy more tomorrow morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ほかにも必要でしたらお声をかけてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If you need anything else, please let us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about your car, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店の駐車場から戻ったら、ドアに新しい傷がありました。どう説明すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車後に新しいドア傷を見つけたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I returned to my car in the shop's parking lot, there was a new scratch on the door. How should I explain it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice after finding a new door scratch following parking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車は今どこにありますか。けがをされた方はいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is the car now? Has anyone been injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車は店の駐車場です。けが人はいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車の所在とけが人なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The car is in the shop's parking lot. No one is injured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the car's location and say no one is injured. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 停めた時刻と、傷を見つけた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me when you parked and when you found the scratch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二時に停めて、二時半に見つけました。乗る前に写真を撮りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駐車時刻と発見時刻と撮影を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I parked at two and found it at two thirty. I took a photo before getting in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the parking time, discovery time, and photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と駐車した場所を確認しましょう。相手の車などは見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the photo and parking location. Did you see the other car or person involved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手は見ていません。店の入口に近い列の、端から二台目です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手未確認と駐車位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not see them. It is in the row near the shop entrance, second car from the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the other party is unseen and give the parking position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当から現場の確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The person in charge will explain how to check the scene.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を見せます。車を動かす前に、担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を示し移動前に現場確認の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the photo. I would like to hear the instructions before moving the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the photo and request guidance on checking the scene before moving the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、交通の担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to traffic staff. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の宛名についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the address on the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宛先をこのラベルに印刷しました。裏の継ぎ目の上に貼っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先ラベルを裏の継ぎ目へ貼る可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I printed the recipient's address on this label. Is it all right to stick it over the seam on the back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the address label may go over the back seam. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先は表の平らな面へ貼ってください。継ぎ目の上だと、剥がれやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Put the address on the flat front surface. Over a seam it is more likely to peel off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ貼っていないので、表に置き直します。縦長の封筒ですが、横向きでも読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表に置き直し横向き表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not stuck it yet, so I will move it to the front. This is a tall envelope; can it still be read sideways?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move it to the front and confirm the sideways address display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この向きなら住所と名前が読めます。上の料金表示用の場所を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This orientation makes the name and address readable. Leave space at the top for postage markings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上を空けました。差出人のラベルは裏に貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料金表示の余白を空け差出人を裏にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have left the top clear. I will put the sender label on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have left postage space and will put the sender on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。端が浮かないよう、四隅も押さえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Press down the four corners too so the edges do not lift.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四隅を押さえました。雨が心配なので、住所の上に透明なテープを貼ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四隅を押さえ透明テープの使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I pressed all four corners. I am concerned about rain. May I put transparent tape over the address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Press the corners and ask about transparent tape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 文字が隠れず、光で読めなくならない貼り方にしてください。こちらで状態を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not cover the writing or tape it in a way that light makes it unreadable. We will check its condition here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: テープは端だけにします。住所が見えるようにして、この封筒を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字を覆わず端を固定し封筒を差し出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tape only the edges. I will keep the address visible and hand over this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Secure the edges without covering the writing and submit the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拝見してお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check it and accept it. Thank you.
